text: Turn a static mockup into a shareable, interactive prototype for user testing
quote: Turn a static mockup into a shareable, interactive prototype you can test with real people. No PRs, no code review.

text: Generate multiple design directions from a prompt in minutes
quote: Generate a dozen directions in minutes, then narrow down in your primary tool.

text: Automatically apply the team's design system to every generated project for consistency
quote: Claude can also apply your team's design system to every project automatically, so the output is consistent with the rest of your company's designs.

text: Grant colleagues edit access and chat with Claude together in a group conversation on a design
quote: grant edit access so colleagues can modify the design and chat with Claude together in a group conversation

text: Import from GitHub, design files, or local codebase so Claude builds with real components
quote: Import from GitHub, design files, or your local codebase so Claude can build with your real components.

text: Use /design-sync and /design slash commands in Claude Code to pull in design system or work directly on designs
quote: Pull in your design system from Claude Code using /design-sync or work directly in Claude Code with /design.

text: Package a finished design into a handoff bundle Claude Code can build from with one instruction
quote: When a design is ready to build, Claude packages everything into a handoff bundle that you can pass to Claude Code with a single instruction.

text: Export designs to PPTX, PDF, or HTML, or share via an org-scoped link
quote: Export to PPTX, PDF, or HTML, share an org-scoped link, hand off to Claude Code, or send to the apps you already use daily.

text: Use AI-generated adjustment sliders and layout controls to tune spacing, color, and directly drag/resize/align elements
quote: use the adjustment sliders Claude creates to tune spacing and color. Use rich layout controls for quick visual and aesthetic shifts, including to drag, resize, and align elements directly.

text: Feature is off by default for Enterprise orgs and must be enabled by an admin
quote: For Enterprise organizations, Claude Design is off by default. Admins can enable it in Organization settings.

text: Import source material from a web capture, or DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX files
quote: Import from your codebase, a web capture, or DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX files.

text: Web capture tool grabs real elements directly from a live website to seed prototypes
quote: You can also use the web capture tool to grab elements directly from your website so prototypes look like the real product.
